findings.failure: A marker-only exemption also suppresses normal source authority for a product-bearing or multi-commit push; fixed historical-source checks do not establish a workflow-only carrier.
findings.fix: Remove the newly introduced source-authority and persistence exemptions altogether, preserving normal jobs for every subject. Add API-only fail-closed complete push-range admission inside the existing DJC collector before historical acquisition: exact event/repository/before/after/sole parent/single commit and sole modified workflow path. Reject mixed or unresolved ranges. No new scheduler/job or product owner.
findings.rationale: Keeping the existing authority and persistence gates active avoids any marker bypass and avoids introducing a prerequisite classification job. The collector remains read-only with no product commands; normal source-authority work is separate and retains its existing permissions. Update DJC-08 before the repair to make this stricter no-exemption policy explicit.
findings.closure: Fresh focused independent review, then actual collector controls and existing-artifact readback in Actions. Collection never changes the old failed product verdict.

actual_static_depth: Both reviewers read complete single-workflow candidate/diff and relevant historical producer/receipt/projection/upload contracts; root synthesizes their task-conversation reports here.
